name: pie-chart
title: Pie Chart
description: A live pie (donut) chart for json-render chats: how one whole splits into its parts, biggest first with the smallest folded into Other, researched via Parallel, with its API route.
docs:
Turn the card on in the chat (one line in each file, see the comments in them):

  features/chat/chat-catalog.ts:   PieChartCard: pieChartCatalogEntry
  features/chat/chat-registry.tsx: PieChartCard: ({ props, loading }) => <LivePieChartCard topic={props.topic || undefined} streaming={loading} />
  features/chat/chat-steps.ts:     PieChartCard: pieChartLookup

Figures load from /api/pie-chart (installed at app/api/pie-chart/route.ts). The route uses Parallel web search + extract (PARALLEL_API_KEY) and your AI Gateway model to turn the topic into the parts of one whole. Keep AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY set (same as chat). Topic is free text from the user's question.
